rationale: The bug is in the tied_count calculation. When counting the number of tied grades, the code adds the count of students with each tied grade (tied_count += count) instead of counting how many distinct grades have ties (tied_count += 1). For example, if 3 students have grade A and 2 have grade B, it returns 5 instead of 2. This is a logic error in the main computation path - wrong accumulation logic using += count instead of += 1.
